metadata.transportCancellationMechanism: Angular HttpClient active socket abort upon unsubscription (res.on('close') fires with !res.writableFinished, prematureConnectionClosure: true, deliveredStatusCode: null). Late delivery over the wire was NOT observed in browser runtime because connection aborts cleanly; component requestId increments serve as defense-in-depth against hypothetical out-of-order packet arrival.

tests.description: Delayed in-flight discovery race with user Clear (×) mutation. Verifies 2500ms delayed query 'Sài Gòn' is aborted by Angular HttpClient at transport level when user clicks Clear at t=420ms, response is NOT delivered over wire (prematureConnectionClosure), and Sài Gòn results do not resurrect.
tests.notes: Late-delivered-response / requestId discarding was NOT browser-tested over the wire because HttpClient cleanly aborted the TCP connection. RequestId is verified in source code as defense-in-depth.

tests.description: Delayed quote calculation positive control with NO UI mutation. Verifies 1500ms delayed quote calculation safely consumes POST request body before delay, completes with HTTP 200, and renders official quote in #quoteSection.

Scenario 1: Date edit mutation during in-flight quote calculation. Verifies 2500ms delayed quote request has body consumed safely, is aborted at transport level when user modifies checkOutDate at t=404ms, and #quoteSection is unmounted with zero stale quote remaining.
tests.notes: Late-delivered-response over wire was NOT observed due to socket abort. Selection reset and unmounting of #quoteSection verified in DOM.

tests.description: Scenario 2: Rental mode switch mutation during in-flight quote calculation. Verifies 2500ms delayed overnight quote is aborted at transport level when user switches to 'Theo giờ' at t=410ms, active mode switches to 'Theo giờ', and #quoteSection is unmounted.
tests.notes: Late-delivered-response over wire was NOT observed due to socket abort. Mode switched and #quoteSection unmounted.

tests.description: Fixture HTTP 500 error injection and in-browser retry recovery.
